en: Black‑and‑white vintage street view showing a row of multi‑story buildings with shuttered windows and ornate balconies in an old European city. Large painted letters on one facade read "HOTEL CARLONI." A horse‑drawn carriage with two horses and a driver stands in the foreground on a wide, mostly empty street lined with similar buildings. The printed heading at the top says "TRENTO Via Lunga – Hotel Carloni," and there is a small publisher credit at the bottom.
